```{r setup-mascot_action, include = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
studio_character <- if (exists("studio_character")) studio_character else formals(mascot::mascot)$character
```

```{r mascot_action-try-live, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_try_live("mascot_action")
```

### From a click to your server

```{r mascot_action-flow, echo = FALSE}
guide_flow(
  guide_step("The visitor clicks", htmltools::div(htmltools::tags$strong("Open help"))),
  guide_step(htmltools::tags$code("input$helper_click"), htmltools::div("counts up")),
  guide_step("Your", htmltools::tags$code("observeEvent()"), htmltools::div("opens your help")),
  guide_step(htmltools::tags$code("update_mascot()"), htmltools::div("can answer too"))
)
```

<div class="pg-callout">

<strong>A picture or a button.</strong>
Without a click, the mascot is a picture: you cannot tab to it and it sends no events. With one, it is a button named by its
label, so screen readers say what a click does.

</div>

<div class="pg-callout">

<strong>Supply a label when setting options.</strong>
Setting `tooltip` or `disabled` requires `label`.
To remove the click behaviour, pass `click = mascot_action()` to `update_mascot()`.

</div>

```{r mascot_action-mistakes, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_mistakes_html("mascot_action", studio_character)
```
